# Extract and explore deviation scores

## 0. Data and libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(corrplot)
library(BBmisc)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(cluster)
library(stringr)

```

```{r}
lobes <- read.csv("Output/Components_Lobes/zscores.csv")
```

```{r}
surface <- read.csv("Output/Area/zscores.csv")
```

```{r}
thickness <- read.csv("Output/Thickness/zscores.csv")
```

## 1. Calculation of a global deviation score

```{r}
surface_x <- surface[,c(2,8:75)]
thickness_x <- thickness[,c(2,8:75)]
lobes_x <- lobes[,c(2:7,11:13,17:19,23:25,29:31,35:37,41:43,47:49,53:55)]
  
all_z <- merge(lobes_x,surface_x, by="SubjectID")
all_z <- merge(all_z,thickness_x, by="SubjectID")
```

```{r}
all_z$AverageDS <- rowMeans(abs(all_z[, 7:166]))
all_z$MedianDS <- apply(abs(all_z[, 7:166]), 1, median)
global_score <- all_z[,c("SubjectID","age","sex","group","AverageDS","MedianDS")]
```

```{r}
mean(global_score[global_score$group=="Patient",]$AverageDS)
sd(global_score[global_score$group=="Patient",]$AverageDS)
mean(global_score[global_score$group=="HC",]$AverageDS)
sd(global_score[global_score$group=="HC",]$AverageDS)
min(global_score$AverageDS)
max(global_score$AverageDS)
```

## 2. Percentage of deviations per lobe

```{r}
result_lobes <- lobes %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(X, SubjectID, age, sex, group, site, dataset),
    names_to = "lobe",
    values_to = "z"
  ) %>%
  group_by(lobe, group) %>%
  summarise(
    count_low  = sum(z <  -1.96, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_high = sum(z >   1.96, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n_distinct(SubjectID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_low  = count_low  / n,
    prop_high = count_high / n
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = lobe,
    names_from = group,
    values_from = c(count_low, count_high, prop_low, prop_high),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    total_count_low  = rowSums(across(starts_with("count_low_"))),
    total_count_high = rowSums(across(starts_with("count_high_"))),
    total_prop_low   = total_count_low  / sum(n_distinct(lobes$SubjectID)),
    total_prop_high  = total_count_high / sum(n_distinct(lobes$SubjectID))
  )
```

```{r}
# As we are only interested in S, K, I components
result_lobes <- result_lobes[1:24,]
```

## 3. Percentage of deviations per region
